## Outcome

Describe the observable change and its user or operator value.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Persistent-format, protocol, process-topology, and support-tier changes have an ADR.
- [ ] Credentials, private paths, and file contents are absent from commits and test output.
- [ ] Conflict preservation and crash recovery remain explicit.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were written or updated before implementation.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Native evidence is attached for every target whose support claim changes.
- [ ] Documentation, changelog, and Graphify context are current.
